name: Hard hat
summary: Yellow safety helmet with a brim and central ridge; for construction, site safety and worker scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the brim rests on the floor at y

params.name: s

params.name: anim
params.note: hop = the helmet jumps up and lands again
